policy: Canonical es-419 seseo and yeísmo; lexical primary stress/word boundaries retained. Phonetic proxy, not a claim about every regional voice.

probes.assumption: NFC normalization
probes.reason: Canonically equivalent accented forms must not become distinct readings.

probes.assumption: NFC normalization
probes.reason: Canonically equivalent enye must retain the nasal-palatal contrast while normalizing equally.

probes.assumption: Canonical ordinary Spanish forms
probes.reason: Silent h should not invent a sound contrast; controlled words outside the ordinary bank.

probes.assumption: Same isolated-word context and canonical b/v merger
probes.reason: Letter differences alone must not create distinct Spanish phoneme keys.

probes.assumption: Same isolated-word context and canonical b/v merger
probes.reason: A medial b/v spelling difference should not create a false distractor contrast.

probes.assumption: Selected Latin American seseo policy
probes.reason: The z/s spelling distinction is not an es-419 phoneme distinction.

probes.assumption: Selected Latin American seseo policy
probes.reason: Soft c before e and s should share the selected pronunciation.

probes.assumption: Canonical es-419 yeísmo; not a claim that all Spanish dialects merge ll/y
probes.reason: Under the declared merger, these controlled forms should be excluded as same-reading candidates.

probes.assumption: Same isolated-word context and canonical soft-g/j pronunciation
probes.reason: Contextual grapheme rules are required rather than letter edit distance.

probes.assumption: Primary stress is retained
probes.reason: Changing the stressed syllable must not be discarded as mere accent spelling.

probes.assumption: Primary stress is retained
probes.reason: The phoneme/stress key must distinguish final stress.

probes.assumption: Primary stress is retained
probes.reason: Identical base letters with different stress should not be treated as exact homophones.

probes.assumption: Tap and trill remain distinct phonemes
probes.reason: The existing carro target makes a tap/trill probe relevant; caro is controlled vocabulary only.

probes.assumption: Enye is retained as a distinct segment
probes.reason: Do not remove the tilde from ñ during pronunciation normalization.

probes.assumption: Canonical stressed-i readings; compare the added initial consonant separately
probes.reason: These actual-bank words are distinct; inspection must also preserve stressed i and the i/o vowel sequence.
inspection: Inspect both transcriptions for primary stress on i and separately represented i/o vowel qualities; this is not a listener-validated syllable-timing claim.

probes.assumption: Contextual qu rule with distinct vowel sequences
probes.reason: Qu must not be tokenized as independent q/u sounds; the words remain distinct.
inspection: Inspect queso for the intended k onset without a pronounced u in que.

probes.assumption: Whitespace-delimited lexical boundaries are retained in the prepared representation
probes.reason: Do not let phone concatenation silently erase the two-word phrase boundary.
inspection: Left input has two lexical words; right joined string is only a controlled tokenization probe.

probes.assumption: Whitespace-delimited lexical boundaries are retained in the prepared representation
probes.reason: The ordinary three-word item needs auditable word segmentation.
inspection: Left input has three lexical words; right joined string is not an admitted vocabulary item.

probes.assumption: Full phrase phones and lexical boundaries are retained
probes.reason: A shared station prefix must not collapse distinct transport/police meanings into one sound key.
inspection: Both phrases have three lexical words; retain the complete final noun rather than comparing only estación.

probes.assumption: Selected canonical yeísmo only; yave is a controlled spelling probe
probes.reason: This tests the canonical merger, not a universal prediction of Buenos Aires or Caribbean acoustics.
inspection: Listen to actual llave recordings in all four regions; a canonical transcription does not model voice-specific ll/y realization.

probes.assumption: Selected canonical yeísmo
probes.reason: Medial doubled ll allophone must map to consonantal y, without changing a single j glide.

probes.assumption: Retain the phonemizer glide versus stressed vowel sequence
probes.reason: Do not erase a real glide/stressed-vowel contrast while normalizing ll.
